full_name: Intan Paramaditha | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Fiction & Poetry Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Macquarie University (Australia)
bio: Intan Paramaditha is an Indonesian-born novelist, scholar, and feminist activist whose work—spanning literary fiction, decolonial feminist theory, and collective organizing—asks how power moves through bodies and borders and what Global South feminist storytelling can do to resist and reimagine.
